update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.38 - Configurable live view frame rate
Added ----- - Live View Frame Rate (Debug Settings, under Remote Log Viewer): the live screen feed's frame rate is now a slider (1-60 fps, default 3) instead of a fixed ~2.5 fps. Higher is smoother but uses more CPU/bandwidth alongside the bot's own automation, so it's worth tuning down if the bot itself slows down. Values above ~10 fps are realistic mainly on a desktop-hosted emulator (e.g. MuMu Player) rather than a phone. Takes effect immediately on an already-open live view, no reconnect needed.
